model_meta.description: Conceptual structural and behavioral model of the bearing and segmented cage arrangement described in the patent.

subsystems.description: Bearing ring on the inner side of the rolling elements.
Bearing ring on the outer side of the rolling elements.

Multiple separate cage segments with lateral boundary walls defining rolling-element receiving pockets and first and second running surfaces configured to guide the pocketed rolling element (claims 2–3). Disclosed alternatives include rolling-element-, raceway-, flange-, or shoulder-guided segments; one-piece plastic molded segments; and cylindrical or tapered rolling elements (claims 4–11), without selecting a single variant.
Rolling elements received in cage-segment pockets and positioned between the inner and outer rings.
In the separate-segment embodiment, a second set of rolling elements occupies gaps between adjacent cage segments.

requirements.statement: In the load-free state, pocket circumferential clearance c on the pitch circle satisfies cmax ≥ c ≥ cmin, where cmin=0.01*Dw−0.5 mm and cmax=0.02*Dw−0.4 mm; Dw is at least 50 mm, and c<0.2x under the stated uniform-distribution condition.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1 specifies these clearance bounds and the relationship to total clearance x.

requirements.statement: When load on the cage from an adjacent roller exceeds a predetermined amount, cage deformation clamps the rolling element in its pocket.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; described as a mechanical response of the cage, without a claimed active controller.

actions.name: Deform cage and clamp pocket roller under elevated adjacent load

steps.description: A load from an adjacent rolling element located outside the cage acts on the cage; represent this as a stated load condition, not as a modeled connection from the pocketed rolling elements.
When the load exceeds the predetermined amount, deform the cage so the rolling element within the pocket is clamped.
